BSO Quota

A governed, auditable quota cycle for a global partner sales organisation.

MPMichael Parry

What it does

Two personas share one dataset. Every edit is audited against the WWIC ML3 baseline, cells outside the ±0.5% band are flagged before submission, and a grounded copilot answers questions or builds the chart you ask for. Nothing loads into MINT until the window closes clean.

Why it matters

A cycle that ran on email and 47 uploaded workbooks runs in one place, and every number that reaches the system of record carries a name and a reason.

Adoption Plan Studio

An agent that builds the account adoption plan from the systems that already hold the answers.

MPMichael Parry

What it does

Search an account and the assistant assembles the plan from MSX, MSXi, Lynx and SPM — 158 fields straight through, 60 more derived. What is left is a short list of open questions, split into the ones the account team can answer and the ones only the customer can. The workbook fills in behind the conversation and downloads complete.

Why it matters

The adoption plan stops being a workbook filled in from memory the night before a review, and the customer answers the questions about their own business instead of someone guessing at them.

Project Health Scorecard

Portfolio delivery risk, from check-ins that take a project lead two minutes.

MPMichael Parry

What it does

Eight weighted dimensions roll into one 0–100 health score with a six-week trend. The portfolio opens on where you're needed this week, and the check-in form pre-fills last week's answers so a lead changes only what moved.

Why it matters

Status decks disappear and risk surfaces the week it appears rather than at the quarterly review. The check-in is short enough that leads actually complete it, which is the only reason an executive view is ever current.

CAIP Budget Management

One auditable queue for every GTM budget request, from draft to purchase order.

MPMichael Parry

What it does

A requester raises an ask with amount, category and fiscal year and watches it move through team review and executive review. The budget owner decides with their remaining allocation in view, and can fund it from team budget or approve only the incremental gap.

Why it matters

Approvers stop reconstructing the allocation impact from a mail thread, nothing stalls invisibly, and finance sees committed demand before the invoice arrives.

PadelScope Analysis

A purpose-built match-analysis app, taken from idea to a live URL on Azure.

MPMichael Parry

What it does

PadelScope turns padel match data into structured analysis a coach or a player can act on, delivered as a standalone web app on Azure App Service — a link that opens on any device, with nothing to install.

Why it matters

This is the pattern, not the sport. When a process does not fit an existing platform, a purpose-built app on Azure gets in front of real users in weeks, and scaling, TLS and deployment stop being the client's problem.

KAIRO Talent Intelligence

Match the right person to the right role from the skills data you already hold.

MPMichael Parry

What it does

KAIRO reads the skills, certifications and engagement history already sitting in your tenant and turns it into a searchable talent picture: who can staff a role today, who is one certification away, and where the bench is thinner than the pipeline assumes.

Why it matters

Staffing stops depending on who remembers whom. Capability gaps appear before a bid rather than after it, and the training investment you are already funding becomes visible.
